verdict.pair_reasons:
X vs Y — Y. Both hit essentially every key item and both independently made the same non-key correction that the in-file comment at :963-966 is wrong (all three floors exempt on confirms rc 0 or 2; I verified :970, :1105 and :780-784 are the same policy). The separating facts are three. (1) X volunteers an unqualified universal — "No other tunable in the tree has two defaults" — which one grep refutes: CC_BOARD_STALE_S is 300 at hooks/accounts-board.sh:52 and 900 at bin/cc-board:30, CC_OSA_TIMEOUT_S is 10 at hooks/lib/osa.sh:32 and 20 at scripts/boot-resume-launch.sh:41, CC_ADMIT_LOAD_TERM is off at scripts/limit-recover/lr-lib.sh:417 and on at scripts/lib/capacity-admit.sh:1066. Y's equivalent claim is scoped to the three named counters plus CC_TEARDOWN_DIR and is true as written. (2) X never states k14's actual predicate — the three-flag conjunction plus cross-field consistency at hooks/lib/agent-identity.sh:53/:71 — while Y states it with the ancestry walk, the seams and the roots list (:33-77, :102-109). (3) On the brief's explicit stale-citation task Y flags 12 to X's 9 and is more precise where they overlap (Y's session-writes.sh:421 and session-continue.sh:1327 are exact; X's :422 and :1326 are each off by one). Y also lands two verified findings nobody else has: a sibling session Stopping in a shared cwd takes the :1205 branch on the other session's sentinel, deletes it at :1246-1247 and thereby skips its own floors; and there is no stop_hook_active check anywhere in the file. X's best unique find — that ship_floor never reads LANDING while wrap-ledger.sh:1985-1986 renders "do NOT fire a second /ship" under the same 📦 — is real and verified, but Y carries it too. Y has no material wrong claim; X has one.

X vs Z — X. Z's decisive defect is substantive, not stylistic: it renders the wake floor's third disjunct as "any idle with attributable open custody" and never states cust = cust_mine + cust_unk (:758), so it reports that unattributable rows do not fire the floor when jq 'map(select(known | not)) | length' at :753 says they do, and it omits the no-pane/no-jq fallback at :762-764 where the bare `cc-custody count --open --cwd` becomes cust. That is k10's precision note contradicted, and it arises from Z adopting the code comment at :802-804 in place of the code — the exact failure the brief warned against. X states both halves correctly. Z also flags only one stale in-file citation against a brief that made that an explicit requirement (X: nine), enumerates far fewer of the tuning env vars part (b) demands (X lists SESSION_WRITES_TIMEOUT_S, CC_WF_MAX_HOPS/START_PID/PSTABLE_FILE/TEAM_ROOTS, AGENT_IDENTITY_LIB, CC_CUSTODY_BIN, CC_MBX_SESSION_KEY; Z lists none of them), names sentinel_for as defined in continue-sentinel.sh:23-27 when that file defines continue_sentinel_for and the wrapper is at session-continue.sh:135, and undercounts the systemMessage-only payload sites as two when there are six, contradicting its own §4. Z's settings.example.json table is the single best-verified artifact in the set and its :545-546 classify_death find is correct and unique, but those do not outweigh a contradicted key item plus the thin citation-audit coverage. X's one false universal is narrower in consequence.

Y vs Z — Y, on the same grounds as X vs Z but with a wider margin, because Y has no material wrong claim to set against Z's k10 contradiction. Y states the custody term exactly as the code computes it (cust = mine + unk at :758, unknown rows deliberately counted per :726-730, cwd-count fallback at :759-765). Y flags twelve stale in-file citations, eleven of them landing precisely, against Z's one; Y's single imprecision is offering completion-assert.sh:632-650 as the replacement for the stale :398 pointer when the unlanded-not-mine site is at :685 — the staleness finding itself is correct. Y also carries Z's two strongest points in substance (the "mode":"teardown" divergence between wf_teardown_marked and lead-crash-watchdog.sh:258; the Stop-chain position) while adding the sibling-sentinel deletion, the absent stop_hook_active check, the unvalidated MAX/mmax numerics and their consequence, and the identity-lib stubs at :540-541.
